Name: Junimo's Spirit's Eve
Author: EnderTedi
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VrRqVbu.png[/img][left][i]﻿Double double Toil and Trouble,
[/i][i]Fire burn and caldron bubble,
Cool it with a baboon's blood,
Then the charm is firm and good

[/i][/left][left]Fall is upon us, the spooky holidays approach, and the Junimos appear...
Wait!? [b]The Junimos appear!?[/b]

Help Toil the Red Flaming Apple and Trouble the Green Poison Apple organise a Spirit's Eve festival just for the Junimos through a fall questline.
Originally made as part of the October 2023 Stardew Valley Discord Mod Jam.[/left]
